name: Password Sign-In Is Locked Out
summary: The user submits password credentials for a locked account, no session is established, and the client receives a lockout-specific result that can drive recovery or support guidance.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the identified durable identity is password-enabled and locked out

inputs.name: Password
inputs.description: Password submitted for an account whose sign-in state is locked out.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt password authentication, detect the account lockout state, and return a lockout-specific result without establishing a session.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and account-status remains locked-out and auth.sign-in.unable is visible

sourceReferences.note: PasswordSignInAsync treats SignInResult.IsLockedOut as a distinct branch, records PasswordAuthenticationFailed, and returns AuthUserLockedOut.
Existing recovery surface provides password recovery and email-change actions while presentation details for lockout remain to be reconciled.
Scenario review keeps lockout distinct from generic rejection because it represents materially different account state and next actions.
